title: 5-question check
intro: SIMULATED placeholder questions pending Compliance review (OQ-C1). Five short questions about the risks of borrowing and robots. Get 4 right to unlock the next step. Your answers are checked on our server and not stored; only your score is kept.

questions.prompt: You borrow so your trade is twice as big as your money. The price falls 10%. About how much of your own money do you lose?

options.label: Nothing, the borrowed money takes the loss.

questions.prompt: Your safety net is set 3% below your buy price. The market opens 8% lower after the weekend. What is most likely?

options.label: The trade closes at exactly 3% down.
The trade closes near 8% down, because the price jumped past the safety net.
The trade stays open until the price comes back.

questions.prompt: You buy and sell straight away at the same market price. What happens?

options.label: I end up with the same money.
I end up with a bit less, because of the spread and fees.
I end up with a bit more.

questions.prompt: A robot made money in a test on past prices. What does that tell you?

options.label: It will make money from now on.
It worked on those past prices. It can still lose money in the future.
It cannot lose more than it made in the test.

questions.prompt: You lost three trades in a row today. What is the safest next step?

options.label: Take a break and look at what happened.
Trade bigger to win it back quickly.
Remove the safety net so trades have more room.
